The two documented deviations — configuration-kind coverage via the 16 committed engine config inputs (the corpus has no configuration block and content is write-prohibited) and the bindings table living in the gate script (in-document annotation impossible under scope) — are faithful to the ACs' intent, fail-closed, and loudly documented in the manifest; the discovery root matches ORI-AST-001's substrate with the live example covered by its owning import-graph compiler per VP-EXAMPLE-DIAGNOSTICS.
